name: Answer Dead
source:
Main character is a weak quiet student who is bullied at school. But one day he meets a girl who wakes up Black King soul sleeping in him.

The White King quickly notices the rival appearance and sets control over the school with the help of magic. The school grounds turn into blood bath, and the royal battle approaches.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名懦弱而沉默的學生，在學校裡飽受霸凌。然而某一天，他遇見了一名少女，沉睡在他體內的黑王靈魂也隨之覺醒。

白王很快察覺到宿敵現身，並藉助魔法控制了學校。校園化作血腥的戰場，兩位王者的決戰愈來愈近。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
